subject: Premium is two coffees a month
body_paragraphs: Quick reframe. Thesis Generator Premium costs about two coffees per month. One Chipotle bowl. 5% of one textbook. That's it.

What you save with Premium: hours of writing time per paper (unlimited essays + Humanize alone saves around 3 hours per assignment), the cost of paying a tutor or editor, and the risk of getting flagged for AI detection on graded work. The math gets uncomfortable when you actually look at it — Premium pays for itself by the second paper of the semester.

The annual plan is even cheaper — works out to roughly one coffee per month. Most serious students go straight to annual at the start of a term. If you've been using the app for 3+ weeks, you're past the trial-curiosity phase. You're a regular. Premium just makes sense.
Tap below to upgrade. P.S. Annual users get priority support and early access to new features — the Research Assistant we're rolling out next month is annual-only at launch.
